source_receipts.locator: Final PDF printed pages 5–6, operative paragraphs 10(e) and 11; registry programme-expenditure disclaimer
source_receipts.claim: OP10(e) directs cost-recovery mission support to BINUH, targeting full responsibility by 1 February 2026. OP11 requires separate quantifiable compacts between the UNSOH head and BINUH head, and between the UNSOH head and GSF Special Representative in consultation with the Force Commander.
limits: A requirement for compacts does not establish that signed compacts were supplied or achieved.
Registry programme expenditure is not expenditure attributable to a mandate.
The original twelve-month GSF authorization cannot establish the current authorization period without follow-up instruments.
